def validate_native_frame(d,n):
    t=(d/(n+'_0000.out')).read_text();m=re.search(r'SKEW SYSTEM SETS.*?VECTORS.*?ORIGIN\s+1\s+0\s+0\s+0\s+([^\n]+)\n\s+([^\n]+)\n\s+([^\n]+)',t,re.S);assert m,'Missing native skew readback'
    axes=np.array([[float(v) for v in line.split()][:3] for line in m.groups()]);expected=np.array([[0,1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,1]])
    p=re.search(r'Isolid  Ismstr   Icpre     NPT ICONTROL\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)',t);assert p
    flags=list(map(int,p.groups()));checks={'axes':bool(np.allclose(axes,expected,atol=1e-6,rtol=0)),'native_flags':flags==[18,2,3,8,0]};dump(d/'native_frame_gate.json',{'created_utc':now(),'axes_rows':axes.tolist(),'expected_axes_rows':expected.tolist(),'native_flags':flags,'checks':checks,'pass':all(checks.values()),'before_Engine':True});assert all(checks.values()),checks
